result:
If I could change one thing, I’d transform education so that every person—regardless of where they’re born—learns critical thinking, emotional intelligence, media literacy, and how to cooperate across differences.

Not indoctrination—just the skills to reason carefully, recognize manipulation, understand other perspectives, and act with empathy. Many of the world’s worst problems—polarization, misinformation, inequality, conflict—are worsened when people lack those tools. If everyone had them, humanity would be much better equipped to solve the rest itself.
